subject.title: fix(channel): bump wecom plugin pin to 2026.7.2 to fix concurrent-message session stuck (#102401)

question: Should this WeCom external package pin bump wait for redacted live WeCom concurrent-message proof, or is the package diff plus catalog/integrity evidence enough to merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but it changes the official external package installed for WeCom users and the PR body does not show a real OpenClaw/WeCom run after the fix.

options.title: Require live WeCom proof
options.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a short recording showing rapid consecutive WeCom messages process sequentially and the session recovers on the updated package.

options.title: Accept source-only proof
options.body: Merge based on the npm tarball diff, exact integrity pin, and targeted catalog tests while knowingly accepting the unproven live upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause the package bump
options.body: Hold or close the PR until the WeCom package owners provide stronger release notes or a narrower fixed package.

recommendation.title: Require live WeCom proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a short recording showing rapid consecutive WeCom messages process sequentially and the session recovers on the updated package.

likelyOwner.reason: Kevin Lin introduced the current OpenClaw official external channel catalog entry and is the strongest OpenClaw-side routing signal for accepting a package-pin upgrade.
